title: What is Lexcia?
content:
Lexcia is a conversational layer for content-rich websites. It helps visitors find and use the knowledge already on a website, through an assistant tailored to the organization.

[About Lexcia](#about)
provenance: Lexcia landing page, website/index.html, section #home; reviewed October 18, 2026.

title: Why Lexcia?
content:
Organizations invest years in valuable content, but visitors can still struggle to find it. Lexcia makes that existing knowledge easier to reach through conversation while keeping the page in view.

[About Lexcia](#about)
provenance: Lexcia landing page, website/index.html, section #about; reviewed October 18, 2026.

title: What can Lexcia customize?
content:
Lexcia tailors the engine, content, interface, behavior, design and integration to your organization and website.

[What we offer](#offer)
provenance: Lexcia landing page, website/index.html, section #offer; reviewed October 18, 2026.

title: How does it work?
content:
We connect your existing content, tailor the assistant, and embed it in your website. The offering includes hosting, monitoring, maintenance, analytics and ongoing improvements.

[How it works](#how)
provenance: Lexcia landing page, website/index.html, section #how; reviewed October 18, 2026.

title: Which websites is it for?
content:
Lexcia is for content-rich websites such as knowledge bases, guides, FAQs, directories and resource libraries, where visitors need help finding information.

[Who it’s for](#for)
provenance: Lexcia landing page, website/index.html, section #for; reviewed October 18, 2026.

title: Can I try Lexcia?
content:
The assistant on this page is the Lexcia demo. It answers brief questions about Lexcia and points visitors to the relevant sections of this landing page.

[Live demo](#demo)

title: How does pricing work?
content:
The planned model is a one-time setup fee plus a monthly subscription, with API usage billed separately. Lexcia is working with an initial group of organizations on discounted terms. The landing page does not list prices. Schedule a demo opens a local scheduling preview for preferred details and an event-summary draft; it does not book a meeting or send a request.

[Schedule a demo](#contact)
